title: Multiplayer Architecture: QUIC Transport & Authoritative Prediction
summary: Explore massive collaborative worlds with sub-millisecond input prediction, server reconciliation, and encrypted QUIC streams.
author: Telos Netcode Team
content: Telos multiplayer is built on an authoritative server model powered by Quinn QUIC over TLS 1.3. Featuring 20 TPS fixed simulation ticks, client-side input prediction, and smooth server reconciliation, player actions feel instantaneous and responsive even over high-latency networks. Server group management with drag-and-drop reordering is now fully integrated into the desktop launcher.
